todos.task: Research existing frameworks and methodologies for evaluating the impact of artificial intelligence on healthcare outcomes and operations
Identify key performance indicators and metrics for measuring the effectiveness of artificial intelligence in healthcare
Develop a comprehensive evaluation framework that incorporates clinical, operational, and financial metrics
Analyze case studies and real-world examples of artificial intelligence implementation in healthcare to inform the evaluation framework
Draft a detailed report outlining the evaluation framework and its application to various artificial intelligence trends in healthcare
Validate the evaluation framework through expert review and testing with sample artificial intelligence use cases in healthcare
